sources.title: GitHub repository metadata
sources.finding: 114 stars, MIT, homepage helicon.sh, TypeScript, pushed 2026-11-16.

sources.title: Release v0.23.4 assets
sources.finding: Latest release 2026-11-16 with Windows x64 setup exe, universal/arm64/x64 macOS DMGs, Linux AppImage, deb and rpm, helicon.vsix, signatures and latest.json.

sources.title: README
sources.locator: intro; Idea; Architecture; Roadmap; Install; Remote daemon; What leaves your machine; Legal
sources.finding: Free MIT desktop app and VS Code extension for Meta Muse Code CLI; projects, sessions, approvals, goals, monitors, file viewer, plan meter, WSL routing, remote daemon, SQLite state; no account or analytics, update check only; unofficial.

sources.title: CHANGELOG
sources.finding: Recent shipped changes: DMG per Mac chip, VS Code image paste, Computer Use approvals naming sent data, WSL distro fix, SDK 1.4.20, long-thread freeze fix.

sources.title: VS Code extension README
sources.locator: What you get; How it works
sources.finding: Side panel for the open folder with threads as tabs, history, readable approvals, inline diffs, plan usage and cost, several Muse accounts, SSH projects, monitors; local server bound to 127.0.0.1.

sources.title: MSP host
sources.finding: Daemon spawns `muse serve` and speaks Muse Session Protocol through the official SDK; no TUI scraping.

sources.title: Local store
sources.finding: SQLite via node:sqlite: projects with pins, hidden, default account; sessions with title source ranking.

sources.title: SSH projects
sources.finding: Projects at ssh://host/path run Muse on the remote host over a passwordless non-interactive ssh stdio connection with keepalives.

sources.title: Server CLI flags
sources.finding: Server binds 127.0.0.1 by default; --host, --token and repeatable --allow-origin enable remote daemon mode.

sources.title: Server
sources.finding: Server aggregates subscription usage windows, thread discovery, titles and host commands.

sources.title: Approval policy parsing
sources.finding: Approval modes Ask first/Full access map to MSP policies onRequest/allowAll etc.

sources.title: Monitors panel
sources.finding: Thread shows background monitors with elapsed time and a Stop button.

sources.title: Workflow model
sources.finding: UI models Muse workflow runs with agents that can be cancelled, skipped or retried.

sources.title: Usage import
sources.finding: Usage store records token calls priced at API rates; also imports oh-my-pi muse-code sessions.

sources.title: Security policy
sources.finding: Pre-release; private advisory reporting; 72-hour acknowledgement target.

sources.title: LICENSE
sources.finding: MIT License © 2026 Harjot Singh Rana and contributors.

sources.title: Demo animation (demo.gif)
sources.finding: Real Helicon window mid-run: project list, thread brisk-photon Working 18s, inline diff, failed and passing test runs, composer.

sources.title: helicon.sh home
sources.finding: Vendor site with downloads, pricing page (free and MIT), changelog and machine-readable facts.

sources.title: Bounded search: accounts, SSO, roles
sources.finding: No accounts, roles or SSO; remote daemon uses a single token.

sources.title: Bounded search: schedules and webhooks
sources.finding: No Helicon scheduler or webhook endpoints; matches are UI strings for Muse features.

sources.title: Bounded search: Git/PR/trackers
sources.locator: grep createPullRequest|gh pr|git commit|worktree add|linear|jira over packages/ apps/
sources.finding: No Git commit, PR or worktree-creation code and no tracker integration; PR watching is done by the Muse agent through monitors.

sources.title: Bounded search: vendor cloud and isolation
sources.locator: grep docker|container|sandbox|vendor cloud over packages/ apps/
sources.finding: No vendor runtime or container/VM isolation; matches are WSL and SSH routing code.

sources.title: Bounded search: other harnesses
sources.finding: Only the Muse Code MSP backend is implemented; ACP appears only in docs comparing other editors.

sources.title: Bounded search: telemetry and analytics
sources.finding: Installed builds have no analytics; apps/web/src/demo/tryAnalytics.ts sends page analytics to PostHog only in the hosted helicon.sh/try demo build (VITE_TRY), and the update check goes to helicon.sh with GitHub fallback.

sources.title: Notification model
sources.finding: The UI raises notifications for an approval request, a question, a finished or failed turn and a goal status change, with a user on/off switch, suppression while the window is focused and a 20 second repeat guard.

sources.title: Notifier implementations
sources.finding: The browser build uses the Notifications API and the desktop shell uses Tauri's OS notification plugin; the settings page has a notifications toggle.
